ontology.name: FIBO Loans General (Adapted Subset)
ontology.description: Adapted from EDM Council FIBO Loans ontology for educational use in Ontology Playground. This is a subset model aligned with classes and semantics from LOAN/LoansGeneral/Loans. Source: https://github.com/edmcouncil/fibo — MIT License.

entityTypes.name: Loan
entityTypes.description: Debt instrument whereby one party extends money or credit to another party with repayment obligations. Adapted from fibo-loan-ln-ln:Loan.

entityTypes.name: Borrower
entityTypes.description: Party that signs loan obligations and is responsible for repayment. Adapted from fibo-loan-ln-ln:Borrower.

entityTypes.name: Lender
entityTypes.description: Party that provides loan capital and sets contractual lending terms. Adapted from fibo-loan-ln-ln:Lender.

entityTypes.name: Collateral
entityTypes.description: Asset pledged to secure repayment obligations under a loan agreement. Adapted from fibo-fbc-dae-dbt:Collateral.

entityTypes.name: LoanPaymentSchedule
entityTypes.description: Payment schedule associated with a loan-specific account. Adapted from fibo-loan-ln-ln:LoanPaymentSchedule.

entityTypes.name: Servicer
entityTypes.description: Financial service provider that collects principal and interest on behalf of the lender. Adapted from fibo-loan-ln-ln:Servicer.

entityTypes.name: PaymentHistory
entityTypes.description: Record of actual borrower payments toward principal, interest, and fees. Adapted from fibo-fbc-pas-caa:PaymentHistory.

relationships.name: owedBy
relationships.description: Relates a loan to the borrower obligated to repay it.

relationships.name: originatedBy
relationships.description: Relates a loan to the lending organization that originated it.

relationships.name: securedBy
relationships.description: Relates a secured loan to pledged collateral assets.

relationships.name: repaidBySchedule
relationships.description: Relates a loan to its payment schedule.

relationships.name: servicedBy
relationships.description: Relates a loan to the servicing organization collecting payments.

relationships.name: hasPaymentHistory
relationships.description: Links a payment schedule to payment history records.
